summary: Phase A independent source audit of the 3 user-supplied JEE Main chapter PDFs after tools/import_jee_chapters.py finished ('STAGED 78 chapters; no tests published yet'). The audit was READ-ONLY: no login, no writes to the customer DB, no AI calls and no publish. The auditor (backend/tests/jee_chapter_source_audit.py) re-reads each PDF with poppler pdftotext (bbox + layout), a different engine from the PyMuPDF importer. Per book it checks: the source sha256 against the manifest and the DB book; the parsed.json sha against the manifest and DB (recomputed); cover counts (29/26/23 chapters, x50); and chapter starts detected independently. Per chapter it checks: page range, title and printed timer (60/90/40); the printed +4/-1/0 statement; that there is exactly one key page; a two-way key-table read (word geometry and layout tokens agree, 1-50); the Q1-Q50 anchors on question and solution pages; each DB answer against the source key; each worked 'Answer: X / 10-mark solution' against the key; rubric marks summing to 10, plus Insight, Trap and Quick check; that each question and solution crop contains exactly its own Qn label; the response-type label, the A-D options for MCQ and a numeric key for integer; mcq/integer counts against the printed instruction; full word-coverage (every body word lies in exactly one crop: 0 lost, 0 duplicated); that the stored chapter PDF bytes (via read-only get_object) match the sha and size and that their page text equals the book page range; and the DB rules. RESULT: 78/78 chapters PASS, 3900/3900 keys and 3900/3900 worked solutions agree. MCQ 3398, integer 502 (17 negative integer keys, max 9960). Online timers are Physics 90, Mathematics 120 and Chemistry 70 minutes, overriding the printed 60/90/40, with +4/-1/0 for both MCQ and integer. All 78 sets are status=draft with independent_check=null, 0 published, and the 3 books are status=ready. A negative control (in-memory mutation of a key, a crop rect and a timer) was correctly flagged as FAIL. Figure check (PyMuPDF images and vector drawings): 42,711 objects; the 7 'outside crop' hits were hatch-pattern tile coordinates, and the rendered crops (Physics ch24 Q43 prism, Maths ch14 Q1 graph and solution) are visually complete. No item spans pages. In-memory scoring simulation with tejas.scoring.score on all 78 chapters gave all-correct=200/200, all-wrong=-50 and blank=0. Unicode minus and leading-zero integer answers also score correctly. Preservation: 144 old sets and 11,800 old questions unchanged; 3900 new unique question IDs with 0 collisions; 0 new jobs, solution_requests, manual_solves or ai_solutions referencing new sets; tejas_question_solutions still 7100. Academic spot checks (not certification) of 8 questions all match the keys: Physics ch1 Q1-3; Chemistry ch1 Q31-34; Maths ch14 Q1. The PASS evidence file is /app/test_reports/jee_chapter_source_audit.json. It passed a dry replica of publish()'s gate checks, but publish was NOT executed.

minor.issue: Corrections refuse sets where any question has approved=False. All 3900 new questions (and the existing BITSAT chapter questions) are approved=False, so a later key correction on these chapters would be blocked until approval. This is pre-existing behaviour and does not block publication.

critical_code_review_comments: import_jee_chapters.publish() re-reads the manifest. If the stage is ever re-run on changed bytes, the manifest parsed_sha changes but the existing sets keep their old parsed_sha256 ($setOnInsert). The update filter then silently matches 0 sets, and publish_book would 409. That is safe but confusing, so consider checking update_one.matched_count == 1 and failing loudly.
publish_book makes the whole book live at once with 365-day validity. Confirm this is the intended access window for chapter practice.
Questions carry options 'See original option A..D'. Students rely entirely on the source crop images, so the accessibility text is honest but not a transcription.
